title: M5GFX #447 review: PaperDIY EPD OE off G45, FPC connectors instead of a Grove port

firmware.toolchain: ESP-IDF v6.1, esp32s3, 16 MiB flash, 8 MiB OPI PSRAM

execution.environment: macOS 26.5.1 arm64; Node v26.13.1; ESP-IDF v6.1; local Device Service with paperdiy profile

checks.detail: OPEN, not draft, author ainyan03, 0 comments / 0 reviews before this review, MERGEABLE, base develop 72001da0
7 files +203/-30: m5paperdiy.json, logical_terminals_12.json, regenerated editor bundle, generated pin table (inl/json), generated esp32s3_board_data.hpp, one host test
K159-B sheet 4 EPD1 pin 12 XOE, pin 7 VDD and pin 23 TEST all on the EPD_PWR net; G45 appears only as MCLK EXT_G45 on the FPC-I2S JP2
official PaperDIY PinMap FPC-I2S and FPC-SPI 12+12 terminals match the PR catalog line by line, including PYG0/PYG4/PYG1 and 3V3_AU/3V3_L2
the official PaperDIY page contains no Grove or HY2.0 reference; the removed port_a has no hardware counterpart
gpio_hi/gpio_lo skip pin < 0 (common.hpp:240-241) and pinMode returns for (size_t)pin >= GPIO_NUM_MAX (common.inl:665-668); Bus_EPD uses pin_oe only in powerControl/init
pmic_ops.hpp:192-199 enables EPD_PWR via M5PM1 GPIO2 in board power-on, so dropping the OE drive removes no required power step
node cli/spec.js check -> check passed: 63 board(s), 90 resolved combination(s)
npm test at head with the M5Unified#451 checkout present: 221 tests, 221 pass, 0 fail, 0 skip
emit-pintable, emit-wiring and npm run bundle leave git status empty at head
compare-pintable against M5Unified#451: 55 boards, 2750 values, 4 targets all equal
base display_oe=45 and head display_oe=-1 both complete DRAW1/sleep/wakeup/DRAW2 on paperdiy; last-frame PNG SHA256 b2e0d506... identical, QOM panel counts identical (73 frames / 39959 latched lines)
one gdma-link 'lli full' error line appears identically in base and head before the first flush and does not block drawing; not attributable to this diff, not further investigated
gh pr checks at review time: 40/40 pass (Arduino matrix, IDF 5.1.6/6.0.2, catalog and generated sources, host)
pin 5 (conn:fpc_i2s.1) is the only newly added FPC pin without a verified block; the other ten use roles: datasheet. Non-blocking provenance nit
no physical PaperDIY was used; the author's own hardware sleep/wakeup check was not re-run
the QEMU ET047TC1 model does not model the XOE net or EPD_PWR rail, so the OE attribution rests on the schematic, not on emulation
